mapper.select: SELECT * FROM eval_criterion WHERE position_id = #{positionId} ORDER BY sort_order, id
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), 0) FROM eval_criterion WHERE position_id = #{positionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO eval_criterion (position_id, name, description, category, resume_assessable_yn, source, sort_order) VALUES (#{positionId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{category}, #{resumeAssessableYn}, #{source}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.update: UPDATE eval_criterion SET name = #{name}, description = #{description} WHERE id = #{id}
